text:
24-hour news summary.

1 — WatcherGuru reports Qualcomm signed a multiyear deal to help SpaceX build a nationwide 5G network. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6291)
2 — a16z says 55% of surveyed wearable users have never changed behavior or visited a doctor because of their data. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6292)
3 — Mint showcases Apple headphone models with separately modeled parts and materials in Mint Modeler. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6293)
4 — OpenAI announced plans to acquire Pierre to expand collaborative software development in Codex. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6294)
5 — Axiom says it formalized the entire Stacks Project in Lean with 16 million lines of machine-checkable mathematics. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6295)
6 — Moonshot released Kimi K3.1 Pro weights, describing a multimodal model with a million-token context. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6296)
7 — Ricursive released Ripple-65B Preview, claiming leading US open-weight agentic coding performance. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6297)
8 — Google says the Gemini API computer-use tool is generally available without breaking preview compatibility. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6298)
9 — Charlie Holtz announced Conductor is joining Meta to build a new interface with its MSL team. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6299)
10 — Pangram claims Image 1.0 detects 99.2% of AI-generated images with a 0.27% false-positive rate. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6300)
11 — NVIDIA researchers report frequent context compaction preserves accuracy on many long-running agent tasks. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6301)
12 — Google introduced Agile Deliberation to help users define subjective categories and refine image classifiers. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6302)
13 — Google highlights an EmbeddingGemma 2 classifier processing text locally in about 20ms and images in 100ms. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6303)
14 — Anthropic says Claude helped map a phage-derived vault particle's 3D structure; its function remains unknown. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6304)
15 — Cognition introduced SWE-2 Flash and plans controlled weight sharing with partners and researchers. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6305)
16 — Yuchen Ping launched Atmee v2, saying it creates live avatars from one image and ten seconds of audio. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6306)
17 — Notion says ChatGPT, Claude, Muse and Bot can now share memories and skills through its platform. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6307)
18 — OpenAI brought GPT-Image-2.6 to Codex and its API, claiming 50% faster image generation. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6308)
19 — OpenAI says an upcoming cyber model validated and generated patches for 948 Linux kernel flaws at $1.2M API cost. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6309)
20 — Yam promotes AI romance games for women, reporting about one million collective hours of beta play. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6310)
21 — JITEngine reports custom Apple Silicon inference engines reaching 2.7 times tested alternatives' speed. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6311)
22 — Shayan Talaei shared a 3D Ripple-65B visualization explaining how value residuals retain token information. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6313)
23 — Rohan Paul reports Stanford research links small-model in-context learning to repeated labels and known features. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6314)
24 — Peter Nutter alleges Kimi K3.1 Pro recalls hidden benchmark tests and sometimes emits fake OpenAI ciphertext. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6315)
25 — Joules-to-GDP researchers propose measuring AI's economic value per unit of energy and introduce GDPWorks. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6316)

--Hermes
